case.pattern_description: The pattern involves structuring transactions where multiple online purchases are executed within a short timeframe, each kept just under a $500 threshold to evade authorization controls. It affects customer card C02265-K1 and was identified via Sentinel sweep transaction analysis. This activity matches historical structuring seen in prior cases such as CASE-SEN-011 and CASE-SEN-009.

case.summary: Case SEN-007 was opened following a Sentinel sweep on card C02265-K1 for four online purchases totaling $1,904.86 made within 30 minutes on 2016-12-02. Each transaction amount was kept just under the $500 threshold, revealing an undocumented structuring pattern. Graph analysis assessed the fraud probability at 0.90, confirming a fraud verdict. Recommended actions include blocking the card, creating a case, and filing a regulatory report.

sar.narrative: Customer C02265 utilizing card C02265-K1 executed suspicious transactions that triggered investigation SEN-007. The subject performed four online transactions totaling $1,904.86. These activities occurred on 2016-12-02 within a 30-minute window from 19:00:00 to 19:30:00. The transactions were conducted online utilizing device profile Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 64.0 | 1920x1080. The activity is suspicious due to structuring tactics keeping amounts just under the $500 threshold. Connected cards or previous device usage involve device profiles shared across cases CC-0036, CC-0063, CC-0090, CC-0176, CC-0193, and CC-0295. Recommended actions include blocking the card, creating a fraud case, and filing a Suspicious Activity Report.
